items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I'm trying to think about any of the others that they ever play parades, like Deku.

ctx.x: I think I do know him. Yeah.

I'm trying to think about any of the others that they ever play parades, like Deku. That's something we ought to follow up on. Some of the banjo players, some of them even took their banjo on the street. Oh, yeah. I've seen that.
